parameters.name: FirewallSwitch
parameters.description:
The status of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall. Valid values:

- **open**: enabled.

- **close**: disabled.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: MemberUid
parameters.description: The UID of the member account of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: VpcFirewallId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall.

> You can invoke the [DescribeVpcFirewallList](~~342932~~) operation to query the instance ID of the VPC firewall.
